title: Intake and used-record keys
description: Object keys in the intake and used-records buckets. Every variable part is base64url(HMAC-SHA-256(...)), 43 characters, so keys reveal nothing and a retry reproduces the same key.

answerKey.description: intake/answers/{fileKey}.json, fileKey = HMAC(file name key, submissionId)

commentKey.description: intake/comments/{commentKey}.json, commentKey = HMAC(file name key, submissionId + ':' + questionId)

usedLinkKey.description: links/{linkRef} in the used-records bucket. The body is the browser's retry secret hash (64 lower-case hex characters), or 'receipt' when an open-link receipt completed the link.

usedReceiptKey.description: receipts/{HMAC(receipt record key, receiptId)} in the used-records bucket. The body is the linkRef the receipt completed, so a retried claim is recognised.
